# replit — Style Reference

> Unbleached linen desk under a single ember of orange. Weight-400 grotesk headlines tracked to -6% sit on #f6f5f4 linen, 1px hairlines and inset rings do the framing, and #ff3c00 burns once per view.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

This is a warm-linen ember language. The canvas is #f6f5f4 Linen Canvas, which shifts to a #f1f0ee Stone Band for alternating sections, rises to #ffffff Paper for floating menus and white cards, and closes on a #faf5f0 Cream Footer. The chromatic budget is exactly one hue. Orange #ff3c00 fills the Sign up button, outlines secondary actions, colors the word "Replit" inside a headline, and its peach tint #ffb199 is allowed to flood whole bento cards. Every other pixel is a warm grey. Replit Diatype carries the entire hierarchy at weight 400, and size plus aggressive negative tracking (-0.06em at 64px) does the work that bold weights do on most SaaS pages. The steps climb 14 → 20 → 26 → 36 → 48 → 64, close to a Perfect Fourth (1.333). Shapes are soft: 8px controls, 16px cards, and 9999px only for filter pills and round icon buttons. Elevation comes from tonal shifts and a 1px inset ring, and a real shadow appears only on dropdowns. The page reads as a maker's workbench rather than a developer-tools dashboard.

## Tokens — Typography

### Replit Diatype — the only voice, carrying display, UI and body at weight 400 · `--font-replit-diatype`

- **Substitute:** Inter Display at 400, Geist at 400, Hanken Grotesk at 450. Diatype draws marginally lighter than Inter at its nominal 400, so match it with Inter Display at 400 rather than Inter Text. Do not go to 500, which reads visibly heavier than the original.
- **Weights:** 400, 450, 460, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 18px, 20px, 26px, 28px, 32px, 36px, 40px, 48px, 64px, 69px
- **Line height:** 1.0 at 36–69px, 1.1–1.25 at 16–32px, 1.3–1.714 at 12–14px
- **Letter spacing:**
  - Display: -3.84px at 64px, -4.14px at 69px, -2.88px at 48px.
  - Headings: -1.2px at 40px, -1.08px at 36px, -1.28px at 32px, -1.12px at 28px, -0.78px at 26px, -0.72px at 18px.
  - Body: -0.32px at 16px, -0.28px at 14px, -0.24px at 12px.
  - Labels: +0.5px on 12px labels.
  - 0px at 14px body.
- **Role:** Weight 400 at 64px is the signature. Headlines are enormous and quiet, so authority comes from scale and density rather than stroke mass. That is anti-convention for an AI product page, where 600–700 headlines are the norm. Tracking tightens as size grows, from -0.02em at 14px to -0.06em at 64px, which compresses display lines into dense typographic blocks. Weight 700 survives only on 48px pricing numerals, and the 460/450 half-steps show a variable font being tuned rather than switched.

### Replit Diatype Mono — the uppercase eyebrow, a technical stamp above sans headlines · `--font-replit-diatype-mono`

- **Substitute:** JetBrains Mono at 500, Geist Mono at 500, IBM Plex Mono at 500. Diatype Mono at 500 renders medium-light, and JetBrains Mono at 500 matches it closely. Avoid 600, which reads as code emphasis.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 13px
- **Line height:** 1.2
- **Letter spacing:** +1.56px at 13px (+0.12em)
- **Role:** The mono face appears only as uppercase eyebrows ("FREE MODE", "REPLIT CHAT", "INTELLIGENT MODEL ROUTING"). It is punctuation rather than decoration. It reminds the reader this is a code platform while the sans does all the selling. The +0.12em tracking is the exact inverse of the display's -0.06em, and that opposition sets every bento card's rhythm.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Replit Diatype | 400 | 12px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Replit Diatype Mono | 500 | 13px | 1.2 | 1.56px | `--text-caption` |
| body | Replit Diatype | 400 | 14px | 1.714 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| subheading | Replit Diatype | 460 | 20px | 1.4 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Replit Diatype | 400 | 26px | 1.2 | -0.78px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Replit Diatype | 400 | 36px | 1.0 | -1.08px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Replit Diatype | 400 | 48px | 1.0 | -2.88px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Replit Diatype | 400 | 64px | 1.0 | -3.84px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline at weight 400 and tighten tracking with size, -0.02em at 14px down to -0.06em at 64px. Quiet weight plus dense tracking is the signature.
- Keep #ff3c00 to one filled button per viewport and use 1px #ff3c00 outlines for every secondary action. Ember is rationed punctuation.
- Let orange become surface only through tints: #ffb199 fills, gradients and glows behind 16px-radius cards. Area in peach reads warm, area in full ember reads alarm.
- Separate sections by stepping #f6f5f4 to #f1f0ee and back, with 120px vertical gaps. Tonal bands replace divider lines.
- Put a 13px Diatype Mono weight 500 uppercase eyebrow with +1.56px tracking above every feature heading. The mono stamp is the code-platform signature.
- Use 8px radius on controls and 16px on cards, and reserve 9999px for filter pills and 32px round icon buttons. The three-step shape vocabulary keeps the page soft but tool-like.
- Frame resting components with a 1px inset ring (rgb 219, 218, 211) and use `--shadow-md` only on floating menus. Shadow means the element truly floats.

### Don't

- Don't bold the headlines to 600 or 700 to "add punch". Weight 400 at 64px is the whole thesis, and heavy display type turns the page into a generic AI landing page.
- Don't fill a whole bento card with flat #ff3c00. Saturated area at full strength competes with the Sign up button, and only gradients and #ffb199 tints may carry orange area.
- Don't introduce a second accent hue, such as a blue link color or a green success fill, on marketing surfaces. The chromatic budget of one hue is non-negotiable.
- Don't use pure #000000 for text or #ffffff for the page canvas. The warm #312e2e on #f6f5f4 pairing is what makes ember read as heat, and cold neutrals make it read as error.
- Don't turn the primary button into a 9999px pill. 8px is measured on Sign up, and pills are reserved for selection tabs, so mixing them blurs action and filter.
- Don't add drop shadows to cards at rest. Resting elevation is a 1px ring or a tonal shift, and anything beyond 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.02) breaks the flat linen field.
- Don't apply positive tracking to Diatype sans. The +1.56px spacing belongs to Mono eyebrows only, and loosening 36px headings past -1.08px dissolves the dense display texture.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f6f5f4 (Linen Canvas)
- section band: #f1f0ee (Stone Band)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- primary text: #312e2e (Graphite Ink)
- secondary text: #4b5563 (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #dbd9d3 (Quartz Border)
- accent tint: #ffb199 (Peach Glow)
- primary action: #ff3c00 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use #312e2e and #dbd9d3 neutrals for bars and axes, highlight one series with #ffb199 at 100% or #ff3c00 at 40% opacity, and never render more than one bar in solid #ff3c00, so the accent stays quieter than the page's single CTA.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. **Primary Action Button.** Build a primary action button labeled "Sign up". Use background #ff3c00, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 12px and height 38px. Set the font to Replit Diatype (fallback Inter Display) at 14px weight 500 with letter-spacing -0.28px and line-height 20px, and no shadow. On hover darken the background 6% via a filter, never via a new hex. Pair it on the left with a ghost "Log in" button: transparent background, #37383c text at 14px weight 400, box-shadow inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(216, 224, 228), radius 8px, padding 0 12px, the same 38px height, with an 8px gap between the two.

2. **Hero Section.** Build a hero section on a #f6f5f4 background with a centered column and 120px top padding. Add an h1 "What will you build?" in Replit Diatype at 64px weight 400, line-height 64px, letter-spacing -3.84px, color #37383c. Below it at 16px, add a subline at 14px weight 400, line-height 24px, color #4b5563. At 24px below, place a composer about 640px wide: background #f1f0ee, 1px solid #ffb199 border, radius 16px, 12px padding. It holds a borderless textarea (14px, color #181818, radius 6px, padding 6px) and a 32px round send button (radius 9999px, background #ffb199 when empty and #ff3c00 when filled). Behind the composer, place a blurred #ffb199 radial glow at 40% opacity. Below the composer, add a row of 32px mode tiles (background #f1f0ee, 1px #dbd9d3 border, radius 12px, 12px #4b5563 labels) and 4px-radius prompt chips with 4px 8px padding.

3. **Bento Feature Card.** Build a 2×2 grid at 1380px max-width with a 12px gap. Each card has a 16px radius, 24px padding, no border and no shadow, and is about 440px tall. Card one is background #ffb199. It holds an eyebrow "FREE MODE" in Replit Diatype Mono 13px weight 500, uppercase, letter-spacing 1.56px, color #312e2e. Below it, 8px down, sits a heading "Create without token costs" at 36px weight 400, line-height 36px, letter-spacing -1.08px, color #312e2e. Below that, 16px down, a 14px weight 400 description sits at line-height 18.2px with -0.28px tracking. Card two is background #f1f0ee with the same type. Under the grid, center an outline button: background #faf5f0, 1px solid #ff3c00, text #ff3c00 14px weight 500, radius 8px, padding 8px 16px.

4. **Navigation Bar.** Build a sticky navigation bar 80px tall on background #f6f5f4 with no border and content constrained to 1380px. On the left place the wordmark in #37383c followed by triggers "Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Enterprise" and "Resources". Each trigger is 14px weight 400, color #37383c, padding 8px 12px, radius 6px, height 36px, with a hover background of #f1f0ee. On the right place a text link "Contact sales" (14px #37383c), a ghost Log in button and an ember Sign up button (#ff3c00, #ffffff, radius 8px, height 38px), with an 8px gap between items. Dropdowns open as #ffffff panels with radius 8px, padding 24px and box-shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12). Group labels inside are 12px weight 500, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.5px, #6f6c6a.

A hairline frame. The spec is a transparent background with #37383c text, no CSS border but the inset 1px ring `--shadow-sm`, an 8px radius, 0 12px padding and a 38px height, set in Replit Diatype at 14px weight 400. It sits beside the ember button at an identical height so the pair aligns. The ring instead of a border is intentional: the box size never shifts when state changes.

### Sticky Linen Navigation Bar
**Role:** Persistent top chrome

Flat and transparent-feeling. The bar is sticky at 80px height on #f6f5f4 with no bottom border, and it holds a 1380px content width. The logo sits left and is followed by triggers (Product, Solutions, Pricing, Enterprise, Resources). Each trigger is 14px weight 400 #37383c with 8px 12px padding, a 6px radius and a 36px height. Contact sales, Log in and Sign up sit right. The nav deliberately shares the canvas color, so it reads as part of the page rather than a header slab.

### Mega Menu Panel
**Role:** Grouped product and resource links

The one floating surface. The spec is a #ffffff panel with an 8px radius, `--shadow-md` (0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)) and 24px padding. Group labels are 12px weight 500 uppercase with +0.5px tracking in #6f6c6a. Links are 14px weight 400 in near-black #040404 (not a system token, so build them with #181818 Onyx Pill) with 8px 0 padding. Panels overlap one another in columns, and the only real drop shadow in the system lives here because these panels genuinely float.

### Hero Prompt Composer
**Role:** The product, embedded in the hero

The page's center of gravity. The spec is a #f1f0ee fill with a 1px #ffb199 border and a 16px radius, roughly 640px wide and 56px tall at rest, with a soft Peach Glow halo bleeding behind it. The textarea inside uses a 6px radius, 6px padding and 14px weight 400 text in near-black (#18191b, mockup-internal, snapped to #181818). A 32px circular send button with a 9999px radius fills with #ff3c00, which renders as #ffb199 while empty. The composer is the outlier that legitimately wears orange at rest, because it is the CTA.

### Mode Selector Tile
**Role:** Choose app type before prompting

Small square toggles. The spec is a 32px tile with a #f1f0ee fill, a 1px #dbd9d3 border and a 12px radius, holding a 16px monoline icon in #37383c. A 12px weight 400 #4b5563 label sits 8px below, and tiles are spaced 32px apart and flanked by arrow scrollers. The tiles behave as icon buttons, not cards, so they never get padding or shadow.

### Example Prompt Chip
**Role:** One-click starter prompts

A near-sharp suggestion. The spec is a #f1f0ee fill with a 1px #dbd9d3 border, a 4px radius, 4px 8px padding and 14px weight 400 #312e2e text, laid out in a row with an 8px gap beneath a 12px #6f6c6a hint. The 4px radius is intentionally tighter than buttons, so chips read as typed text fragments rather than actions.

### Bento Feature Card — Tinted
**Role:** Headline product capabilities

A colored slab. The spec is a 16px radius with 24px padding and no border or shadow, laid out in a 2×2 grid with a 12px gap. Fills rotate between #ffb199 Peach Glow, a full-bleed photograph, a #f1f0ee Stone Band and an ember radial gradient (decorative). Inside, a 13px Diatype Mono weight 500 uppercase eyebrow with +1.56px tracking sits above a 36px weight 400 heading with -1.08px tracking in #312e2e or #ffffff, then 14px body. This is where orange is allowed to become area, as long as it is tint or gradient, never flat #ff3c00.

### Filter Pill Tabs
**Role:** Switch template categories

The only true pills. Each pill uses a 9999px radius, 4px 12px padding and 14px weight 400 text, with a 1px #c5c5c599 border on a transparent fill. The active pill flips to a #181818 fill with #ffffff text and no border. These pills are the system outlier on two axes, full rounding and an inverted fill, and that is allowed because selection state needs the highest contrast on a mostly orange-free strip.

### Template Thumbnail Card
**Role:** Showcase of user-built sites

A frame for others' work. The spec is an 8px radius with a 1px #c5c5c599 hairline and a #ffffff backing, holding a full-bleed screenshot at roughly 16:10. Cards sit in a 4-column grid with a 12px gap on the #f1f0ee band. The frame stays neutral so wildly different user designs (serif menus, jazz posters, dark dashboards) can coexist without clashing with the chrome.

### Platform Pillar Card
**Role:** Four-up platform value statements

A tall, warm-stepped column. The spec is a 16px radius with 16px padding and no border. A 14px weight 400 label sits above a 26px weight 400 heading with -0.78px tracking in #312e2e, followed by an inset illustration. Fills step from #ffffff through decorative taupe #dbd4cf, peach #f9aa8b and a deeper orange (both decorative, not system tokens). The four-card ramp is a temperature gradient that walks the reader from neutral to ember.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline at weight 400 and tighten tracking with size, -0.02em at 14px down to -0.06em at 64px. Quiet weight plus dense tracking is the signature.
- Keep #ff3c00 to one filled button per viewport and use 1px #ff3c00 outlines for every secondary action. Ember is rationed punctuation.
- Let orange become surface only through tints: #ffb199 fills, gradients and glows behind 16px-radius cards. Area in peach reads warm, area in full ember reads alarm.
- Separate sections by stepping #f6f5f4 to #f1f0ee and back, with 120px vertical gaps. Tonal bands replace divider lines.
- Put a 13px Diatype Mono weight 500 uppercase eyebrow with +1.56px tracking above every feature heading. The mono stamp is the code-platform signature.
- Use 8px radius on controls and 16px on cards, and reserve 9999px for filter pills and 32px round icon buttons. The three-step shape vocabulary keeps the page soft but tool-like.
- Frame resting components with a 1px inset ring (rgb 219, 218, 211) and use `--shadow-md` only on floating menus. Shadow means the element truly floats.

### Don't

- Don't bold the headlines to 600 or 700 to "add punch". Weight 400 at 64px is the whole thesis, and heavy display type turns the page into a generic AI landing page.
- Don't fill a whole bento card with flat #ff3c00. Saturated area at full strength competes with the Sign up button, and only gradients and #ffb199 tints may carry orange area.
- Don't introduce a second accent hue, such as a blue link color or a green success fill, on marketing surfaces. The chromatic budget of one hue is non-negotiable.
- Don't use pure #000000 for text or #ffffff for the page canvas. The warm #312e2e on #f6f5f4 pairing is what makes ember read as heat, and cold neutrals make it read as error.
- Don't turn the primary button into a 9999px pill. 8px is measured on Sign up, and pills are reserved for selection tabs, so mixing them blurs action and filter.
- Don't add drop shadows to cards at rest. Resting elevation is a 1px ring or a tonal shift, and anything beyond 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.02) breaks the flat linen field.
- Don't apply positive tracking to Diatype sans. The +1.56px spacing belongs to Mono eyebrows only, and loosening 36px headings past -1.08px dissolves the dense display texture.

## Elevation

- **Resting cards, chips, inputs:** `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(219, 218, 211), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02)`
- **Log in ghost button:** `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(216, 224, 228)`
- **Mega menus and dropdown panels:** `0 8px 24px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)`

## Imagery

Imagery splits into three registers. First come product mockups, such as chat bubbles, a Free/Power/Max mode switcher and an authentication diagram, drawn as flat UI fragments directly on card fills. Second come user-built template screenshots framed at 8px radius with 1px #c5c5c599 hairlines. Third is one lifestyle photograph (a person on a phone) used full-bleed as a bento background, with a decorative green-dark tone (#2c3328, not a system token). Nothing gets a drop shadow. Icons are 16px monoline outlines in #37383c with rounded terminals, matching the weight-400 type. Gradients are decorative only: a Peach Glow halo behind the hero composer and blurred ember orbs inside the Model Routing card, never a system token for buttons. The narrative is "your idea becomes these real artifacts".

## Layout

Content sits within a 1380px max-width, centered on #f6f5f4, with 120px between sections. The hero is a single centered column: a 64px weight-400 headline, a 14px Slate Caption subline 16px below, then the composer, a mode-tile row and prompt chips, with generous empty canvas beneath. Sections alternate linen and #f1f0ee Stone Band to create rhythm without rules. Features use a 2×2 bento with a 12px gap, templates a 4-column grid, platform pillars 4 columns, and pricing 3 columns of roughly 453px cards. The nav is sticky at 80px, visually transparent on linen, with the logo and five triggers left and Contact sales, Log in and Sign up right. The footer is a 610px #faf5f0 field with multi-column link lists. At 375px, drop display to 36px with -1.08px tracking, use 64px section gaps and collapse grids to one column. The overall density is comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f6f5f4 (Linen Canvas)
- section band: #f1f0ee (Stone Band)
- elevated surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- primary text: #312e2e (Graphite Ink)
- secondary text: #4b5563 (Slate Caption)
- hairline: #dbd9d3 (Quartz Border)
- accent tint: #ffb199 (Peach Glow)
- primary action: #ff3c00 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use #312e2e and #dbd9d3 neutrals for bars and axes, highlight one series with #ffb199 at 100% or #ff3c00 at 40% opacity, and never render more than one bar in solid #ff3c00, so the accent stays quieter than the page's single CTA.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. **Primary Action Button.** Build a primary action button labeled "Sign up". Use background #ff3c00, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 12px and height 38px. Set the font to Replit Diatype (fallback Inter Display) at 14px weight 500 with letter-spacing -0.28px and line-height 20px, and no shadow. On hover darken the background 6% via a filter, never via a new hex. Pair it on the left with a ghost "Log in" button: transparent background, #37383c text at 14px weight 400, box-shadow inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(216, 224, 228), radius 8px, padding 0 12px, the same 38px height, with an 8px gap between the two.

2. **Hero Section.** Build a hero section on a #f6f5f4 background with a centered column and 120px top padding. Add an h1 "What will you build?" in Replit Diatype at 64px weight 400, line-height 64px, letter-spacing -3.84px, color #37383c. Below it at 16px, add a subline at 14px weight 400, line-height 24px, color #4b5563. At 24px below, place a composer about 640px wide: background #f1f0ee, 1px solid #ffb199 border, radius 16px, 12px padding. It holds a borderless textarea (14px, color #181818, radius 6px, padding 6px) and a 32px round send button (radius 9999px, background #ffb199 when empty and #ff3c00 when filled). Behind the composer, place a blurred #ffb199 radial glow at 40% opacity. Below the composer, add a row of 32px mode tiles (background #f1f0ee, 1px #dbd9d3 border, radius 12px, 12px #4b5563 labels) and 4px-radius prompt chips with 4px 8px padding.

3. **Bento Feature Card.** Build a 2×2 grid at 1380px max-width with a 12px gap. Each card has a 16px radius, 24px padding, no border and no shadow, and is about 440px tall. Card one is background #ffb199. It holds an eyebrow "FREE MODE" in Replit Diatype Mono 13px weight 500, uppercase, letter-spacing 1.56px, color #312e2e. Below it, 8px down, sits a heading "Create without token costs" at 36px weight 400, line-height 36px, letter-spacing -1.08px, color #312e2e. Below that, 16px down, a 14px weight 400 description sits at line-height 18.2px with -0.28px tracking. Card two is background #f1f0ee with the same type. Under the grid, center an outline button: background #faf5f0, 1px solid #ff3c00, text #ff3c00 14px weight 500, radius 8px, padding 8px 16px.

4. **Navigation Bar.** Build a sticky navigation bar 80px tall on background #f6f5f4 with no border and content constrained to 1380px. On the left place the wordmark in #37383c followed by triggers "Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Enterprise" and "Resources". Each trigger is 14px weight 400, color #37383c, padding 8px 12px, radius 6px, height 36px, with a hover background of #f1f0ee. On the right place a text link "Contact sales" (14px #37383c), a ghost Log in button and an ember Sign up button (#ff3c00, #ffffff, radius 8px, height 38px), with an 8px gap between items. Dropdowns open as #ffffff panels with radius 8px, padding 24px and box-shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12). Group labels inside are 12px weight 500, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.5px, #6f6c6a.

## Quiet Display Weight

The discipline is that hierarchy is carried by size and tracking, never by weight. Every heading from 26px to 64px is weight 400, and tracking tightens proportionally: -0.03em at 26–40px and -0.06em at 48–64px. What breaks it is a designer reaching for 600 to make a section title stand out, or leaving display type at default 0px tracking, which makes the 64px line look loose and unfinished. To extend the system, add new heading sizes on the Perfect Fourth (for example 85px for a campaign hero) and assign -0.06em tracking. Use the 460 half-weight only for 20px subheadings, and keep 700 locked to pricing numerals at 48px where digits need mass.

## Ember Rationing

The chromatic budget is one hue, and it is spent in three strengths. Full #ff3c00 is allowed only on the single filled action, outline line work and one headline keyword. #ffb199 is allowed as card area, borders and glows. Gradients mixing the two are allowed only as decorative card art. What breaks it is a second filled ember button in the same viewport, ember body text, or a new hue (blue links, green badges) creeping into marketing surfaces. To extend it, express new states as neutral shifts: a #181818 active pill, #f1f0ee hover fills or a #dbd9d3 hairline. If emphasis is unavoidable, use an ember outline rather than an ember fill.

## Similar Brands

- **replit** — Claude.ai/Anthropic: shares the warm off-white canvas and single coral-orange accent, though Anthropic leans on a serif display where Replit stays in a tight-tracked grotesk.
- **replit** — Lovable: shares the prompt-composer-as-hero structure and peach/orange glow behind the input, but Lovable spreads multi-hue gradients where Replit holds to one hue.
- **replit** — Vercel v0: shares the centered "what will you build" composer with template chips below, though v0 runs on cold neutrals and black CTAs rather than warm linen and ember.
- **replit** — Notion: shares warm-grey text on a near-white canvas and section separation by tonal bands, but Notion's illustrations are ink line drawings where Replit uses colored bento slabs.
- **replit** — Framer: shares weight-400 display type with heavy negative tracking and user-work galleries, though Framer's dark canvas inverts the whole surface stack.
